description: Methods contract. Each top-level property is a method id. A method describes how an input is ingested into an immutable Batch artifact: input shape, extraction instrument, optional XML parsing profile, privacy rules, semantic keys, and Batch-level type enforcement.

schema_domain.description: Semantic domain of the method. Used during configuration loading and Batch preparation to ensure that a method is compatible with the selected stream. For example, an SDO method must only be used with an SDO stream.

type.description: Extraction instrument type. Used by .resolve_extraction_instrument() to select the extractor function, e.g. extract_xml() for type 'xml' or extract_access_db() for type 'access_mdb'.

xml_profile.description: Code-driven XML parsing profile used by extract_xml(). Required only when type is 'xml'. It selects the registered parser strategy, e.g. 'sdo_tracciato_ab', without describing XML nodes or parsing rules declaratively.

input_type.description: Expected shape of the inbox input. Used by .validate_input_type() during Batch preparation to abort early if a method expecting a directory receives a file, or vice versa.

input_map.description: Reserved legacy field for explicit input role mapping. It is currently not consumed by the Batch materialization or XML extraction pipeline. Do not rely on this field until a concrete loader uses it.

components.description: Legacy method component definition. For directory-based XML methods, components are used by .resolve_inputs() to resolve physical input files before extraction. For Access/MDB methods, components are currently used by extract_access_db() as the list of source tables to extract. This field is intentionally retained for compatibility but is overloaded; future contracts should split physical input components from logical output/source tables.

oneOf.description: List of component names. Suitable for methods where component names are sufficient and no file pattern is needed.
Mapping from component name to file glob pattern. Used to resolve one concrete input file per component inside the inbox directory.

anchor_table.description: Name of the required anchor table produced by the method. Used by Batch/Bronze validation to ensure the batch contains the required core table, and by Silver-current to select the latest version of each entity.

identity_keys.description: Column names that identify an entity within the stream. Used by Silver-current to partition the anchor table and to join secondary tables back to the selected current anchor version using identity_keys + __batch_id.

partition_column.description: Domain-time column associated with the anchor table. Historically used for Bronze partitioning. In the DuckDB pipeline it remains method metadata for inspection, future semantic enrichment, and possible harmonized/fiscal logic, but it is not used to determine Silver-current.

pseudonymize.description: Columns containing sensitive identifiers that must be pseudonymized during Batch materialization. Used by apply_privacy_rules() before Batch Parquet files are written.

skip.description: Columns that must be removed during Batch materialization. Used by apply_privacy_rules() before Batch Parquet files are written.

column_types.description: Per-table column type enforcement rules applied during Batch materialization after privacy rules and before Parquet writing. Used by .apply_batch_column_types(). This protects semantic codes such as DRG, diagnosis codes, procedure codes, and administrative identifiers from being stored as numeric values.

additionalProperties.description: Column type rules for one output table produced by the method. The object key is a column name and the value is the enforced target type.
Supported target type. Currently only 'character' is allowed because the implemented enforcement protects code-like values from numeric coercion and leading-zero loss.
